title: Mobility & Accessibility Aids Quarter-over-Quarter Volume Shift
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wheelchair:battery
| bin _time span=1q
| stats count as events by _time
| streamstats current=f last(events) as prev_q by _time
| eval qoq_pct=round(100*(events-prev_q)/prev_q,1)
| where isnotnull(prev_q) AND prev_q>0
| sort - _time
description: Compares event volume quarter over quarter for mobility telemetry in index=personal.
value: Seasonal life domains swing a lot; a quarter view separates real habit change from normal summer/winter noise without overreacting to one bad week.
implementation: Keep `wheelchair:battery` events flowing into `index=personal` with stable timestamps, then review QoQ percent change during quarterly personal ops reviews.
visualization: Column chart of events by quarter with QoQ percent labels.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps how much your mobility activity changed compared with last quarter so you can tell a real shift from normal seasonal ups and downs.
